title: Path24 model comparison
legend: All ten released primary Path24 candidate equivalence classes, ranked by delta CICc from the best model. The dashed line marks delta CICc = 2; blue circles pass the global d-separation fit gate and vermillion triangles fail it. The cell-bridge class ranks first. Estimated genome size is the D. fuscus assembly-anchored pg/1C estimate derived from IOD, not an independent species C-value. These exploratory model comparisons do not orient causal arrows within an equivalence class.
alt_text: Ten ranked equivalence classes have delta CICc points; only the best cell-bridge class has a blue global-fit passing symbol.

title: Simulation calibration
legend: True-class top-model recovery in 100 simulations per generating-class and residual-regime combination, retaining all eight released rates and the complete 0-100% scale. Colours and symbols distinguish Brownian and independent residuals. Unequal and incomplete recovery qualifies the path-model comparison. Estimated genome size refers to the IOD-derived assembly-anchored trait; these simulations do not establish unique causal directions.
alt_text: Paired points show recovery rates for four generating classes under Brownian and independent residuals on a zero-to-100-percent axis.
